lines.zh: 我一步一步踩着枯草过来
lines.en: I come step by step over the dead grass.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我知道你跑不掉
lines.en: I do not run; I know you cannot get away.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被我踩成灰色
lines.en: The soil turns grey under my feet.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草就没了
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass is gone.

lines.zh: 我的步子很慢，但一直朝你
lines.en: My steps are slow, but always toward you.
Head low, my teeth showing.

lines.zh: 我沿着你留下的痕迹走
lines.en: I follow the marks you left.

lines.zh: 这具身体很瘦，肚子却空得发响
lines.en: This body is lean, and my belly growls hollow.
I come around the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我走得不稳，像随时会散架
lines.en: I walk unsteadily, as if I might come apart.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方开始干枯
lines.en: The ground dries where I pass.

lines.zh: 我一步不停，饿着走过来
lines.en: I do not pause; I come on hungry.

lines.zh: 我站着，只是看着你那个方向
lines.en: I stand, simply facing your direction.

lines.zh: 我没有眼皮，只能一直盯着。
lines.en: I have no eyelids, so I can only keep staring.

lines.zh: 这具身体瘦得能看见骨头
lines.en: This body is thin enough to show bone.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，什么也没咬到
lines.en: I open my mouth and bite nothing.

lines.zh: 空气里全是我身上的味道
lines.en: My smell fills the air around me.
I wait, and I am very patient.

lines.zh: 我不需要睡觉，也不需要停
lines.en: I need neither sleep nor rest.

lines.zh: 我身上挂着干掉的草屑
lines.en: Dry grass clings to me.
The birds have gone quiet.
I look down at my own hands.

lines.zh: 饥饿不是感觉，是我本身
lines.en: Hunger is not a feeling; it is what I am.

lines.zh: 我微微偏头，听你的呼吸
lines.en: I tilt my head to listen to your breathing.
My teeth are long, and still growing.

lines.zh: 这里迟早归入饥饿原野
lines.en: This will all belong to the Starved Plains.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，看起来像一截枯木
lines.en: Standing still, I look like dead wood.
The color is draining from the dirt.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，慢慢放下
lines.en: I raise a hand and lower it slowly.
I look at you squarely, unflinching.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气我闻得到
lines.en: I can smell the warmth on you.
I lean forward slightly.
No need to run; I always arrive.

lines.zh: 我的嘴角往上扯了一下
lines.en: The corner of my mouth pulls up.
You are looking at my teeth.
Only a few steps between us.
I move my foot first.

lines.zh: 我不急，饿的人最有耐心
lines.en: I am not hurried; the hungry are the patient ones.
My shadow is longer than yours.

lines.zh: 这一片已经没别的活物了
lines.en: Nothing else living remains here.
I step back, then stop.

lines.zh: 这一下砍进了我的身体
lines.en: That cut into my body.
I do not cry out; I only grow hungrier.
No blood in the wound; it is dry.
My teeth clamp harder.
I press a hand to the break.
Pain will not make me leave.

lines.zh: 你打的每一下，我都记得
lines.en: I remember every blow.

lines.zh: 活的东西靠近，我就想咬
lines.en: When something living comes close, I want to bite.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西，我不认识
lines.en: I do not know what you are holding up.

lines.zh: 我闻到味道，头立刻转过来
lines.en: I catch a smell and my head snaps over.
I am not picky; whatever can be bitten, is.
I edge closer without startling you.
That is not enough.
I open my mouth; drool falls on the soil.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉味，让我往前挪。
lines.en: The meat scent on you pulls me forward.

lines.zh: 我从来不拒绝送上门的东西
lines.en: I never refuse what walks up to me.
I stretch my neck out.
You slam in; I do not retreat.
My body is thin, but hard.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我们贴得很近
lines.en: That collision brought us very close.
I put a hand out and steady you.
You are knocked back; I keep coming.
My shoulder bone is sharp.

lines.zh: 我们撞过，我记住了你的重量
lines.en: We collided; I remember your weight.
The dead grass crunches beneath us.
I did not dodge, and need not.
Do not stand this close; I will bite.

lines.zh: 我们这样的东西，也有成对的
lines.en: Even things like us come in pairs.
She walks steadier than I do; I admit it.

lines.zh: 我们一起走过原野，草就全死了
lines.en: We cross the plains together, and the grass dies.
I hold the path while she goes in.

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，饿的时候都懂
lines.en: No words; when hungry, we both know.

lines.zh: 两颗饥饿之牙，并排放着
lines.en: Two hunger teeth laid side by side.
Her shadow is shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起等，比一个等更快
lines.en: Waiting together is faster than waiting alone.

lines.zh: 她从那边过来，我往这边让
lines.en: She comes from that side, so I yield this one.

lines.zh: 原野会记住我们走过的路
lines.en: The plains will remember the path we walked.
This will not break; I spit it out.
I grip it, nails digging in.
I sniff it before taking it.

lines.zh: 它在我手里很快就干了
lines.en: It dries quickly in my hand.
I tie it at my waist.
I pick it up, look, and throw it away.

lines.zh: 地上没有别的东西可捡
lines.en: There is nothing else to pick up here.
I press it into the soil.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，是为了让你看见
lines.en: I pick it up so you see me do it.

lines.zh: 不管你站多高，我都能上去
lines.en: However high you stand, I can reach it.
I know the smell of something alive.
You are the only thing moving here.
I have started after you.

lines.zh: 你跑得比我快，可你不会一直跑
lines.en: You are faster, but you cannot run forever.
I hold you in my sight.

lines.zh: 地上的草在替你留记号
lines.en: The grass leaves marks for me.
I have been hungry too long.
I follow without slowing a step.
You hide behind a tree; I go around.
I do not roar; roaring costs strength.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在枯草上很响
lines.en: My steps are loud on the dead grass.

lines.zh: 你越跑，这片地枯得越快
lines.en: The faster you run, the faster the ground dies.
I need not hurry; I never tire.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸我听得清清楚楚
lines.en: I hear your breathing perfectly.
I wait for you to trip.
The treeline ends here.
For the last steps, I stop holding back.
I bite down; my teeth are long.
I seize you, nails biting in.
This is not a strike; it is a gnawing.
I am only at ease once you are pinned.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下头，撕下一块
lines.en: I whip my head and tear a piece loose.

lines.zh: 你不觉得疼，是因为太快
lines.en: You feel no pain because it was too quick.
After the bite, I keep chewing.
My hands never stop grabbing.

lines.zh: 一口下去，连骨头都不剩。
lines.en: One bite, and not even bones remain.
The grass here yellows first.

lines.zh: 我从原野的边缘走出来
lines.en: I walk out from the edge of the plains.
The colors in the air thin out.
No land can keep me out.

lines.zh: 我踩下的第一脚，土就干了
lines.en: The first step dries the soil.

lines.zh: 你听见那种沙沙声了吗
lines.en: Do you hear that rustling?

lines.zh: 我是一个走过来的饥饿
lines.en: I am a hunger that walks.
The animals far off have fled.

lines.zh: 这地方很快就会变成原野
lines.en: This place will soon be plains.

lines.zh: 我没有跟着谁来，我只是饿
lines.en: No one led me here; I am only hungry.
The birds fall silent when I appear.

lines.zh: 火烧掉我身上一层，我又长出来
lines.en: Fire burns a layer off, and I grow it back.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔成一堆
lines.en: I fall from height and land in a heap.
Water fills me and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得退了很远
lines.en: The blast pushes me far back.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我身上，我没管
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me; I ignore it.
That force holds me still.
I am always hungry, hungry to the bone.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我烧了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes me; I burn briefly.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我一直在掉
lines.en: No ground; I keep falling.
